Title: Local Agent
Description: Download the MyDevTools Local Agent installer for Windows x64 and review its version, checksum, permissions and tray controls.
SeoTitle: MyDevTools Local Agent for Windows x64 — Download
Keywords: MyDevTools local agent, Windows x64 download, local agent installer, no account
PrivacyShort: The agent connects directly from your PC to the target; MyDevTools does not proxy requests
HeroTitle: Connect browser tools to your Windows PC
HeroDescription: The Local Agent gives selected MyDevTools tools an explicitly authorized capability on your machine. The installer places it in your user profile, needs no account, and is controlled from the Windows tray.
SetupIntro: The download is a per-user installer. It places the agent in your user profile. Running a newer installer replaces that copy.
Step1Body: Download the installer. Running it again with a newer build replaces the installed agent.
Step2Body: Open the installer. It stops an agent that is already running, then writes the new copy. Windows may ask you to confirm a downloaded app. Administrator access is not required.
Step3Body: Enter the fresh code shown by the agent into the MyDevTools tool. Pairing grants only the capability that tool requests.
PermissionsIntro: The agent is not an account, remote service or general command runner.
PermissionAccount: No sign-up, login or MyDevTools cloud proxy.
PermissionInstall: No administrator rights and no Windows Service. The installer is for the current user only.
PermissionPairing: A rotating one-time code starts a time-limited browser session. The browser stores the connection token for up to 8 hours or until the agent restarts, but never stores the pairing code.
PermissionNetwork: It listens only on this PC. HTTP requests and ICMP probes go directly from the agent to the target. Private-network targets are blocked by default. Routers seen along a path are shown even when they use a private address.
TrayIntro: Closing the small window hides it; the tray icon opens it again.
TrayCode: View the version and current pairing code.
TrayAutostart: Autostart is opt-in and off by default. It uses your Windows user settings and follows the installed agent when a newer installer replaces it.
TrayExit: Exit stops the local server and revokes active sessions completely.
CapabilityBody: This release can pair HTTP requests, ICMP path traces, DNS lookup, TCP connect, TLS inspection, WHOIS, and ASN lookup. Each tool asks for its own named capability; pairing does not grant future capabilities automatically.
VerifyBody: This installer is not digitally signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn or block it. Do not disable Windows protection. Compare the SHA-256 value above with the downloaded file to check integrity; a matching hash is not a publisher signature.
